skills.name: Ferry the Dead
skills.description: Upon entering the battlefield, deals DMG equal to 200% ATK to the farthest unit and banishes them to the Underworld for 8 seconds. Banishment: The target is exiled from the battlefield, unable to act, and cannot be targeted by either side. When all units on the battlefield are in the Banishment state, Banishment is forcibly canceled.

upgrades.level2: Deals DMG equal to 250% of ATK to the target.
upgrades.level4: Deals DMG equal to 300% of ATK to the target.

skills.name: Lanternfire Torrent
skills.description: Continuously channels a beam at the current target, dealing DMG equal to 100% of Charon's ATK per second. For every 3 seconds of channeling, this DMG multiplier increases by 25%, up to a total increase of 200%. Consumes 150 Energy per second during the duration. If the target Falls/enters Stealth/becomes Untargetable during channeling, ends the channeling and restores 600 Energy to self.

upgrades.level2: Deals 120% self ATK as DMG per second to the target.
upgrades.level3: Consumes 100 Energy per sec for the duration.
upgrades.level4: Deals 140% self ATK as DMG per second to the target.

skills.name: Passage Denied
skills.description: When any enemy unit approaches Charon, he inflicts Banishment on them for 3s. Skill CD: 30s.

upgrades.level4: When triggered, grants a Shield equal to 500% of ATK.

skills.name: Styx Descends
skills.description: Charon slowly summons the River Styx into the mortal realm. When Charon has not moved for 8s, he gains the [River Styx] state. This state is cleared upon moving. River Styx state: Increases DMG dealt by 40% and Lifesteal by 20%.

upgrades.level2: In the River Styx state, increases DMG dealt by 45%.
upgrades.level3: In the River Styx state, increases ATK by 50%.
upgrades.level4: In the River Styx state, increases DMG dealt by 50%.

relic.name: Ferryman's Stance
relic.description: For every 1s of channeling, Lanternfire Torrent's DMG multiplier increases by 25%, up to a total increase of 250%.

upgrades.level2: When Charon is about to fall, he becomes Immune to the DMG and Invincible for 3s, and inflicts Banishment on the enemy unit that dealt the DMG.
upgrades.level3: While in the River Styx state, is immune to 3 Crowd Control effects.
upgrades.level4: For every 1s of channeling, Lanternfire Torrent's DMG multiplier increases by 40%, up to a total increase of 800%.

coreMechanic.summary: Sustained channel damage (Lanternfire Torrent) that scales the longer it is held, paired with a stationary River Styx state that boosts damage and Lifesteal when Charon does not move. His defensive tools use Banishment to remove threats from the battlefield temporarily rather than killing them outright.
